content: We found it easier to reproduce or exceed BIBREF2's results for general-domain BERT, compared to their results for BioBERTv1.0 (see Figure FIGREF13, main paper). While this may be due to hyperparameters, it suggests that BioBERTv1.0 was more strongly tuned than BERT in the original BioBERT paper. This observation does not affect our conclusions, as GreenBioBERT performs better than reproduced BERT as well.
